cases.why: the Weekly update clause asks for success instead of failure, so a run that failed on purpose after committing last week's grades leaves them off the page until some other build happens (the 2026-09-28 audit's finding)
the clause names a workflow that is not the Weekly update; GitHub matches on the display name, so it never fires and nothing says so
the NBA daily run drops out of the failure clause, so a night Line Judge flags leaves that night's committed picks off the page (the 2026-11-02 review's finding)
